articles.title: Ukrainian police took down a crypto scam that stole up to $1 million a month
articles.snippet: Investigators have identified 62 victims and say more than 46 Ukrainians took part in the alleged operation.

articles.title: U.S. added stronger than expected 162,000 jobs in August as labor market bounced back
articles.snippet: This morning's report will be key as the Fed considers whether to raise interest rates at its September policy meeting.

articles.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

articles.title: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
articles.snippet: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.

articles.title: Polymarket Launches Crypto Perpetual Futures With Up to 20x Leverage
articles.snippet: The prediction market platform's new Perps product scaled from 10 markets to 67 on its first day—though the 20x leverage ceiling only applies to some of them, and none of it reaches U.S. traders.
